concerns.text: The plan states "Collect human feasibility scores for **all 1 000 prompts** (FR‑001 & FR‑009 reconciled)" (lines 2‑4). This directly conflicts with FR‑009, which only requires human scores for **at least 200 prompts**. If only 200 are annotated, the paired statistical tests on the 500 conflicting prompts will be under‑powered, violating the power analysis (Section 7) that assumes 500 annotated conflicting samples. The inconsistency undermines the methodological validity of the study.

The plan does not specify any randomization or counterbalancing of the order in which the baseline, graph‑augmented, and control conditions are presented to the verifier. Without randomizing condition order, there is a risk of order effects (e.g., model state carry‑over, caching) confounding the observed performance differences.
